Phillips Antiques is a highly reputed antique store with a rich legacy, well known among celebrities. Honestly, I never imagined I would have the opportunity to purchase from them just by visiting their website. To my delight, I found their dealings to be exceptionally transparent and quite reasonable, especially considering their legacy and standing.
What truly touched me was the patience and humility with which Claudette handled each of my queries. She sincerely took my questions to the experts and ensured I received detailed answers. Even Mr. Farooq, the proprietor himself, being a very busy man — responded personally whenever he had the time. That level of involvement speaks volumes about their commitment to customers.
The art pieces were packed with utmost care. The attention to detail was evident, with documentation elegantly placed inside an envelope [I loved it], adding a personal and thoughtful touch to the entire experience.
I look forward to purchasing more antiques from Phillips Antiques and will definitely visit their store whenever I am in Mumbai. Thank you for such a memorable experience — it truly meant a lot to an art lover like me. Everyone does business, but very few do it with such grace !!

featured_reviews.name: Sapna Moudgil-Shah

featured_reviews.name: anjitha mekkayil anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
Phillips Antiques, nestled in the heart of Mumbai's heritage district near Colaba, is more than just a shop; it's a living museum steeped in history. Established in 1860, this family-owned establishment is one of the oldest antique stores in the city, and stepping inside feels like a journey back in time.
The carefully curated collection is a treasure trove of colonial-era finds and exquisite pieces from across Asia. From magnificent carved wooden furniture – beds, armchairs, settees, and marble-topped tables – to delicate Victorian curios, gilded mirrors, and religious statues, every item tells a story. You'll find a fascinating array of lamps, lithographs, old maps, and photographs of pre-Independence Bombay, offering a nostalgic glimpse into the city's past.
The true charm of Phillips Antiques lies not just in its impressive inventory, but also in the passion and knowledge of its proprietors. They are more like curators, happy to share the provenance and significance of each piece, making the Browse experience educational and truly captivating. While the prices reflect the rarity and quality of the items, even if you're not in the market to buy, a visit to Phillips Antiques is a must for anyone with an appreciation for history, art, and the unique allure of old-world charm in modern Mumbai.
